result.summary: Reviewer 15 (overview aggregation, counts/latest result/current run/token accounting, pagination) at target d428e0f730ed5649485732e95d39c32f5d6a8895. Verdict FINDINGS: 1 HIGH + 2 MEDIUM, all reproduced with local fake providers. HIGH: src/mcp.ts:44 caps responses at 131072 bytes, but list_workers returns each worker error verbatim (src/security.ts:143) and Store.finish copies result.summary (max 4000 chars, src/domain.ts:44) into it, so ~30 failed workers make the CLI limit:100 page (src/cli/client.ts:77-80) 133473 bytes and fail swarmforge status outright. MEDIUM: client.inspect calls get_worker_logs with no cursor (src/cli/client.ts:101-104), so events.slice(-8) (src/cli/overview.ts:256) renders the OLDEST page and hides the current run past 100 events. MEDIUM: out-of-band pause branches (src/coordinator.ts ~419, ~500) omit inference.delete(), unlike applyControl, so inference_requests_active over-reports. All latent: 5672ead..d428e0f touches none of them. See artifacts/review.md.
result.details:
Setup: assigned /workspace/repo left clean at baseline 5672ead (untouched). Disposable detached checkout at /tmp/rv15/target, git rev-parse HEAD verified = d428e0f730ed5649485732e95d39c32f5d6a8895. Snapshot Bun is 1.3.14 (cannot read lockfileVersion 2), so official Bun 1.4.2 was installed at /tmp/opencode/bun142 and used throughout; bun install --frozen-lockfile exited 0 (125 packages) and the lockfile was never rewritten. No code fixes, commits, pushes, worker spawning, or config changes were made.

Scope: src/mcp.ts aggregation tools and pagination cursors; src/store.ts (all, tokens, result, events, tasks, teams, dispatch, usage upsert); src/security.ts publicWorker; src/cli/overview.ts grouping/counts/render; src/cli/client.ts overview pagination and inspect; src/cli/tui.ts; src/coordinator.ts result/run selection, inference map, claimDispatch, recordProgress; src/metrics.ts; src/domain.ts states/terminal/resultSchema; docs/MCP-API.md.

Finding 1 (HIGH, reproduced end-to-end): in-memory MCP server plus MCP client, 40 failed workers each with a 4000-char summary passed through Store.finish. list_workers{limit:20} succeeded; list_workers{limit:100} returned isError=true with 'Response exceeds limit; request a smaller page'. Replaying the verbatim cli/client.ts overview loop reproduced OVERVIEW FAILED. Byte sweep by worker count at 4000-char summaries: 20=88993 (ok), 29=129025 (ok), 30=133473 (exceeds). No test asserts page size against the cap (grep for 'exceeds limit|131072' in tests/ returns nothing), and tests/overview.test.ts uses only 2-event timelines.

Finding 2 (MEDIUM, reproduced): 40 simulated follow-up turns produced 121 events; the default page ends at event id 100 while the newest is id 121. With deterministic one-minute event timestamps the rendered TIMELINE ended at 01:40:00 and the true newest event 02:01:00 never appeared. Reachability is normal usage because send_worker_message follow-ups each emit running/result.received/ready.

Finding 3 (MEDIUM, reproduced): harness worker driven to running, snapshot forced to busy with inference_active:1, tick gives estimate 1; setting the provider VM to paused then tick + recover() + tick leaves state paused with the estimate still 1 and the map still holding [worker_id, 1]. Both pause branches omit the delete that applyControl performs, and runTick excludes paused workers so nothing refreshes it. tests/session-status.test.ts:124 asserts the gauge reflects incomplete messages but never exercises an out-of-band pause.

Verified correct with no defect found: get_swarm_status counts, get_task and get_team_status state/token totals, store.tasks and store.teams aggregates, store.result latest-result ordering and run_id-scoped lookup, and next_offset arithmetic for list_workers, list_tasks and list_worker_artifacts. get_worker_result correctly rejects unknown workers via store.get, and finish() is idempotent for duplicate completion.

Delta context: 5672ead..d428e0f does not touch src/mcp.ts, src/store.ts, src/security.ts, src/metrics.ts, src/cli/overview.ts or the client render path, so all three findings are pre-existing at baseline as well as target (latent, not branch regressions).

Artifacts: /workspace/.swarmforge/artifacts/review.md (10433 bytes) and /workspace/.swarmforge/artifacts/findings.json (5518 bytes), both sanitized and under the 24 KiB limit. Reviewer probes live only under /tmp/rv15/probes (a temporary .review-probes dir inside the disposable /tmp checkout was removed; git status there is clean). No secrets or credential-shaped examples appear in any output. Full suite was intentionally not run; only targeted scope tests and local probes with fake providers were executed.

result.followup_reason: One HIGH and two MEDIUM reproducible defects in overview aggregation and pagination: (1) src/mcp.ts:44 / src/mcp.ts:101-118 / src/cli/client.ts:77-80 - list_workers with the CLI's limit:100 can exceed the 131072-byte response cap (30 failed workers with 4000-char summaries = 133473 bytes), turning swarmforge status into a hard error; (2) src/cli/client.ts:101-104 / src/cli/overview.ts:256 - worker-detail TIMELINE renders the oldest 100 events, hiding the current run once a worker exceeds 100 events; (3) src/coordinator.ts pause branches (~419, ~500) leak coordinator.inference entries, permanently inflating get_swarm_status.inference_requests_active and swarmforge_inference_requests_active. Each has a reproduction and a recommended correction in /workspace/.swarmforge/artifacts/findings.json.
